example.title: Cato Post Office and General Store, 13806-13810 U.S. Highway 10
example.source: HABS WI-346 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,36-CATO,1-)

brief: Two-storey frame gable-front general store (a store from 1868) with a lower two-storey flat-roofed side wing, both under one long shed-roofed porch carried on square posts over a raised cut-stone base along the highway. Shop windows and paired doors on the ground floor, one bay lettered 'POST OFFICE'; weathered drop siding, gable-end attic window, utility pole and open lots around it in a tiny crossroads settlement.
